name: Shirogane Takeru
source: Takeru is a typical high school student with a love for the virtual reality mecha battle game Valgern-on. Even though he doesn't do anything for it, he is very popular in school among girls mainly due to his daily fights with his childhood friend Sumika attracting too much attention.
translation: Takeru is a typical high school student with a love for the virtual reality mecha battle game Valgern-on. Even though he doesn't do anything for it, he is very popular in school among girls mainly due to his daily fights with his childhood friend Sumika attracting too much attention.
